task.description: REVIEWER FAILed your rework's SELF-REPORT, not its content (rework iteration 2 of 3). git diff 401080e..357d1c2 -- messages/kk.json actually touches 17 keys, but your step-09 result.summary claimed 'exactly 15 changed lines' and named only 16 keys (12 flagged + Footer.licenseContent + 3 newly-found: Creed.principle2Body, Metrics.sourceNote, Partners.disclaimer). The undisclosed 17th key is Events.lede ('жеті Talk' -> 'жеті баяндама'), which REVIEWER independently confirmed is itself a correct translation (matches ru.json's 'докладов'), but was never named in either your flagged list or your newly-found list. Do NOT re-touch the translation content -- REVIEWER confirmed all 17 values, including the undisclosed one, are substantively correct. This rework is purely to correct the self-report's inventory: verify the actual diff yourself, confirm the full and accurate list of changed keys, and record it correctly this time.
acceptance_criteria: Independently re-derive the actual diff (git diff 401080e..357d1c2 -- messages/kk.json or equivalent against the pre-rework commit) yourself
Confirm the complete, accurate list of all changed keys (should be 17, including Events.lede) in the new handoff's result.summary
No further translation edits to messages/kk.json unless your own re-derivation finds something REVIEWER missed
State plainly why the discrepancy happened (e.g. an untracked edit made during the broader re-scan pass) so it doesn't recur

result.summary: Independently re-ran `git diff 401080e..357d1c2 -- messages/kk.json` (cross-checked with `grep -c '^-.*".*":'` = 17) and confirm the complete, accurate list of 17 changed keys, in file order: Nav.events, Nav.chapters, Hero.ctaPrimary, Band.lede, Creed.principle2Body, Metrics.sourceNote, Doors.door1Body, Doors.door2Link, Events.eyebrow, Events.lede, Map.nodeAlmatySub, Map.ctaLaunchChapter, Streams.stream1Title, Partners.partner1Desc, Partners.disclaimer, Team.team5Role, Footer.licenseContent. This matches REVIEWER's count exactly, including the previously-undisclosed Events.lede ('жеті Talk' -> 'жеті баяндама', matching ru.json's 'докладов'). No content edits were made -- REVIEWER already confirmed all 17 values are substantively correct, and this rework was scoped purely to the self-report inventory, not the translations. Root cause of the discrepancy: my step-09 rework pass covered two separate sweeps -- (1) the 12 keys REVIEWER originally flagged for literal-English domain terms (Event/Chapter/Talk), and (2) a broader self-initiated re-scan of the whole file for the same pattern, which is where Creed.principle2Body, Metrics.sourceNote, Partners.disclaimer, and Footer.licenseContent were caught and fixed. Events.lede was also touched during that second sweep (it contains 'Talk' -> baяндама, the same domain-term pattern), but when I assembled the final self-report I read back only my working notes from the first sweep plus three of the four second-sweep catches, and Events.lede was dropped in that transcription step rather than re-derived from the actual working diff. In short: the report was compiled from memory/notes of what I intended to fix rather than from a fresh `git diff` against the base commit, so a real edit fell out of the inventory. Going forward, self-reports on multi-key content edits should be generated by running the diff command directly rather than reconstructed from sweep notes.
